verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI customer-service agent, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes Fin as a hosted service reached through APIs, MCP, a CLI and helpdesk integrations. The phrase "deploy AI within your own boundaries" is a compliance and controls claim, not a self-hosting or on-prem deployment option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
